# Avatar moved to rows 24-29 (between red and blue)
# Let me try UP again to align with red block (rows 19-22)

# Check avatar
for n in seg:
    if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) < 50:
        b = n['boundary']
        minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
        maxr = max(p[0] for p in b)
        minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
        maxc = max(p[1] for p in b)
        print("Avatar: rows %d-%d, cols %d-%d" % (minr, maxr, minc, maxc))

# Check colored blocks
for n in seg:
    if n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N'] and n['pixels'] == 16 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) < 50:
        b = n['boundary']
        minr = min(p[0] for p in b)
        maxr = max(p[0] for p in b)
        minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
        maxc = max(p[1] for p in b)
        print("Colored %s: rows %d-%d, cols %d-%d" % (n['color'], minr, maxr, minc, maxc))

# Check track
w_blocks = []
for n in seg:
    if n['color'] == 'w' and n['pixels'] == 4:
        b = n['boundary']
        minc = min(p[1] for p in b)
        maxc = max(p[1] for p in b)
        w_blocks.append((minc, maxc))
w_blocks.sort()
print("White blocks cols:", w_blocks)
print("White block count:", len(w_blocks))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
